cost_interpretation: Counters are actual invocations/examples, not FLOPs. CPU and wall means are observations from one execution census with method order and concurrent workload; they are not randomized latency benchmarks. Summed path wall times are not total job elapsed time.
disposition: No admission, no new holdout authorization, no retrospective gate adjustment. Original historical exact-regression FAIL is preserved independently of the numeric field-increment failure.
interpretation: The empirical gate returned the previously selected ordinary baseline at every adaptive decision; this is observed conservative fallback, not evidence that the heads are identical.

Field/richer heads have different predictions and sometimes different unconstrained greedy actions, but no adaptive action was deployed. This run therefore does not compare the gains of active field control against active richer control.
No same-guard field increment was observed; all four predeclared same-guard task/clean comparisons are exactly zero.

Eight-step transactions lowered mean task utility for both observers on all three fixed models and retained fewer gradient microsteps overall; more accepted transaction counts do not mean more retained updates when transaction lengths differ.
Field/richer feature instrumentation incurred actual extra operations despite producing the same trajectory as ordinary.

These results describe this fixed model bank, frozen selected heads, empirical threshold and disclosed development data. They neither refute parameter-field theory in general nor establish the sufficiency of this field representation.
Old calibration labels use fixed Qref continuation and 48-step transactions; the eight-step use remains an empirical surrogate, not a certified policy-improvement bound.
scope: Read-only descriptive analysis of the already disclosed V3 development roles; no new model calls, test outcomes or gate changes
